title: Borel restrictions of admissible representations of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity
statement: Assume (IMC)(b): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R in U of degree n and every Borel set E ⊆ ℝ^P there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' in U with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult and R'.orient = R.orient. Assume (IMC)(d): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P and every IMRep R in U of degree n, for Hⁿ⌞R.carrier-a.e. x (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) one has |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every n-covector α, where |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α. Assume (RU), the frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq: for all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, all measures μ₁, μ₂, μ₃ on ℝ^P that are finite on every compact subset of U and all fields ξ₁, ξ₂, ξ₃ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) such that each ξ_i is μ_i-a.e. strongly measurable and satisfies |ξ_i(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ_i-a.e. x and every k-covector α, if ∫ ξ₁(x)(ω(x)) dμ₁ = ∫ ξ₂(x)(ω(x)) dμ₂ + ∫ ξ₃(x)(ω(x)) dμ₃ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U), then ∫_B ξ₁(x)(ω(x)) dμ₁ = ∫_B ξ₂(x)(ω(x)) dμ₂ + ∫_B ξ₃(x)(ω(x)) dμ₃ for every Borel B ⊆ ℝ^P and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let P, q ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let X, A ∈ 𝒟_q(U) with X integer multiplicity. Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_q(ℝ^P) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and every q-covector α, such that X(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^q(U). Let E ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set with A(ω) = ∫_E ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^q(U) (Bochner integrals). Then A is integer multiplicity.
